defs.def: all the qualities and features that make a person, groups of people, and places different from others （人、集体的）品质，性格；（地方的）特点，特性

ex.s: The Chinese characters “gōng” and “hé” together mean “work together, cooperate.” The original term — gõngyè  hézuòshè — means Chinese Industrial Cooperatives.

ex.s: Although landscapes in the Midwest tend to be quite similar, either farm fields or highways, sometimes I find distinctive character in the hills or lakes.

ex.s: Many people now misunderstand emotional intelligence as almost everything desirable in a person's makeup that cannot be measured by an IQ test, such as character, motivation, confidence, mental stability, optimism and "people skills." Research has shown that emotional skills may contribute to some of these qualities, but most of them move far beyond skill-based emotional intelligence.
ex.t: 现在许多人把情商误解为一个人特质中几乎所有无法用智商测试衡量的可取之处，比如性格、动力、自信、心理稳定、乐观和“人际技巧”。研究表明，情绪技能可能有助于其中一些品质，但大多数远远超出了基于技能的情商。

ex.s: Anger is rarely looked upon as a beneficial character trait, and is usually advised to reduce it.
ex.t: 愤怒很少被视为一种有益的性格特质，通常人们会被建议要减少愤怒。

ex.s: Characters: introducing characters means describing both appearance and personality.

defs.def: the way that sth is, or a particular quality or feature that a thing, an event or a place has （事物、事件或地方的）特点，特征，特色

ex.s: Our life story is something that starts coming together in our teenage years, when we begin to organise our lives into chapters around key events or life changes, and begin to see ourselves as both the central character and, to a varying extent, the story’s author.
ex.t: 我们的人生故事在青少年时期开始成形，那时我们开始把生活围绕关键事件或人生变化整理成一个个章节，并开始把自己视为故事的中心人物，并且在不同程度上也视为这个故事的创作者。

ex.s: Perhaps the first thing that springs to mind when you think of storytelling is the fantasy land that took shape in your mind while Mom or Dad told you stories about princes, castles and monsters, with a unique voice for each character.
ex.t: 想到讲故事，你脑海中浮现的第一件事，或许是爸妈用各自的嗓音为你讲王子、城堡和怪兽的故事时，你心中形成的幻想世界。

defs.def: a person or an animal in a book, play or film/movie （书籍、戏剧或电影中的）人物，角色

ex.s: Yet， now that I'm growing and the world I once knew as being so simple is becoming more complex， I find myself needing a way to escape． By opening a novel， I can leave behind my burdens and enter into a wonderful and mysterious world where I am now a new character． In these worlds I can become anyone． I don't have to write down what happened or what technique the author was using when he or she wrote this． I just read to relax．
ex.t: 然而，随着我渐渐长大，曾经以为如此简单的世界变得越来越复杂，我发现自己需要一种逃避的方式。打开一本小说，我就能抛开烦恼，进入一个奇妙而神秘的世界，在那里我成为一个新的角色。在这些世界里我可以成为任何人。我不必记下发生了什么，也不必分析作者写作时运用了什么技巧。我阅读只是为了放松。

ex.s: The students took on diverse topics and turned in stories, 10 to 20 pages each, with characters that broadened my view and touched my heart.
ex.t: 学生们选择了各种不同的主题，交上来的故事每篇10到20页，其中的人物开阔了我的视野，也触动了我的心。

ex.s: He suggested I think about the difference between endings that I wanted for the characters and endings that were right for the characters, endings that satisfied the story even if they didn’t have a traditionally positive outcome.
ex.t: 他建议我思考：我想要的结局和适合角色的结局之间的区别——那些让故事圆满的结局，即便不是传统意义上的美满结局。

ex.s: But they usually have some elements in common: rather than a list of dry facts, stories have plots and they introduce characters.
ex.t: 但它们通常有一些共同要素：故事不是干巴巴的事实罗列，而是有情节，并且会介绍人物。

ex.s: In 1870, when Dickens died, the world mourned him as its first professional writer and publisher, famous and beloved, who had led an explosion in both the publication of novels and their readership and whose characters — from Oliver Twist to Tiny Tim— were held up as moral touchstones.
ex.t: 1870年狄更斯去世时，世界哀悼这位首位职业作家和出版人，他声名显赫、深受爱戴，引领了小说出版与读者群的爆发式增长，其笔下人物——从奥利弗·崔斯特到小蒂姆——被视为道德试金石。

ex.s: If the plot, characters, or word usage is confusing for you, likely won’t be able to remember what you read.
ex.t: 如果情节、人物或用词让你困惑，你很可能记不住读过什么。

ex.s: Readers are often carried away by character.
ex.t: 读者经常被角色所感染。

ex.s: This kind of planned revisit could also be for confirming certain details in the text, or for checking on the moves of a given character.
ex.t: 这种有计划的重读也可以是为了确认文本中的某些细节，或者查看某个特定人物的动向。

ex.t: 它有情节、场景、人物和动作，以及人物之间的对话。

ex.s: To bring your story to life, describe the settings and characters.
ex.t: 要让你的故事生动起来，请描写场景和人物。

ex.s: A regular character in the letters was Polar Bear,who once climbed the North Pole (an actual pole in this case) and fell through the roof of Father Christmas’s house.
ex.t: 字母中的一个普通人物是北极熊，他曾经爬过北极（在这种情况下是实际的极点） ，从圣诞老人家的屋顶上掉了下来。

ex.s: When he was writing his novels, Charles Dickens would act out the parts of the characters, He’d make faces in the mirror, and change his voice for each character.
ex.t: 查尔斯·狄更斯写小说时，会表演角色的部分，对着镜子做鬼脸，并为每个角色变换声音。

ex.s: She’d just look up at the right time, long enough to answer-in character - “The better to eat you with, my dear,” and go back to her place in the magazine article.
ex.t: 她只是在恰当的时候抬起头——足够长的时间——用角色的语气回答："这样我就能更好地吃掉你了，亲爱的，"然后回到她的杂志文章那里去。

ex.s: To frame his story, Klein creates the character of Ned, a fictional witness to the progress brought about by the steams and electric revolutions in America during one man's lifetime.
ex.t: 为了构建他的故事，Klein创造了Ned这个角色，一个见证美国在一个人的有生之年因蒸汽和电力革命而取得进展的虚构人物。

ex.s: You have to balance creating an ending that's unpredictable, but doesn’t seem to come from nowhere, one that fits what’s right for the characters.
ex.t: 你必须平衡：创造一个出人意料、却又不是凭空而来的结局，一个契合角色应有的结局。

ex.s: Randall Flagg is one of the scariest characters ever.
ex.t: 兰德尔·弗拉格是有史以来最可怕的角色之一。

ex.s: A few characters are used to create a single impression growing out of the theme.
ex.t: 用少数几个人物来创造一个源自主题的单一印象。
